title: Cyclic sort: every value to index value − 1

steps.caption: Cyclic sort: values are 1..n, so value v belongs at index v − 1. Swap each value straight to its home.
3 belongs at index 2: swap it there. Stay at i = 0, the new value here needs placing too.
2 belongs at index 1: swap it there. Stay at i = 0, the new value here needs placing too.
5 belongs at index 4: swap it there. Stay at i = 0, the new value here needs placing too.
4 belongs at index 3: swap it there. Stay at i = 0, the new value here needs placing too.
Every swap puts one value home for good, so at most n swaps: O(n). Afterwards, a slot i not holding i + 1 reveals a missing or duplicate number.
